title: TR-1: Car Listing Creation
source_ref: TR-1: Car Listing Creation | Owners can list a new vehicle with all required specs and pickup location. | Create a listing: "Tesla Model Y 2023", $85/day, Location: "Airport Hub". | Listing appears instantly in the catalog feed with correct details and location badge.
preconditions: Seed state; session is owner Sarah Jenkins (usr_101)
steps: Open the owner listings page and choose Add listing
Enter Make Tesla, Model Model Y, Year 2023, Fuel Electric, Transmission Automatic, Daily rate 85, Cleaning fee 25, a valid image URL, Location (pickup address) Airport Hub
Switch to renter and open the catalog
expected: The listing is saved without errors
The catalog shows a card titled Tesla Model Y 2023 with daily rate $85 and a location badge reading Airport Hub

title: TR-2: Search & Filter Validation
source_ref: TR-2: Search & Filter Validation | Renters can filter inventory by make and maximum daily rate. | Filter catalog by Make = "Tesla" or set Max Daily Rate = $90. | Non-matching cars disappear from the active feed in real time.
preconditions: Seed state; session is renter Alex Rivera (usr_102)
steps: Clear the make filter, then set Max Daily Rate = 90
expected: With Make = Tesla only Tesla cars remain; Ford Bronco and BMW M3 disappear without a page reload
With Max Daily Rate = 90 only cars with a daily rate of $90 or less remain (Tesla Model Y at $85); Ford Bronco ($110) and BMW M3 ($140) disappear

title: TR-3: Dynamic Pricing Math
source_ref: TR-3: Dynamic Pricing Math | Checkout flow calculates total cost accurately based on duration and fees. | Select a 3-day rental for an $85/day car with a $25 cleaning fee. | Checkout summary displays exactly $280.00 ($255 rental + $25 fee).
preconditions: Seed state; session is renter Alex Rivera; Tesla Model Y (car_01, $85/day, $25 fee)
steps: Open the Tesla Model Y details/checkout
Select a start date and an end date three days later that do not overlap Nov 10-13 2026 (for example 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-23)
expected: Breakdown shows 3 days, daily rate $85.00, rental subtotal $255.00, cleaning fee $25.00

title: TR-4: Owner Booking Approval
source_ref: TR-4: Owner Booking Approval | Owners can manage rental request states from their portal. | Log into Owner view, locate a pending booking request, and click "Approve". | Booking status updates to Confirmed across both owner and renter portals.
preconditions: Seed state; book_302 (Ford Bronco, 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-23, renter Alex Rivera) is Pending
steps: Switch to owner Sarah Jenkins and open Booking Requests
Locate the pending request for the Ford Bronco and click Approve
Switch to renter Alex Rivera and open My Bookings
expected: The request status in the owner portal changes to Confirmed
The same booking shows status Confirmed in the renter's My Bookings
